event.label: Nord Stream leaks and investigation
event.description: Claims about the Nord Stream 1 and 2 damage discovered in late September, possible causes, investigation and effects. Suspected sabotage is separate from identifying a responsible actor.

topics.label: Was the damage deliberate?
topics.scope_note: Suspecting sabotage, refusing to rule it out and proving the cause are different levels of certainty.

topics.label: Who might be responsible?
topics.scope_note: Allegations and feasibility opinions are not proof. A state benefiting from damage does not establish it caused the damage.

topics.label: Who should investigate?
topics.scope_note: Gazprom participation and Russian-state cooperation are related but distinct proposals.

topics.label: What damage is reported?
topics.scope_note: Pressure drops, explosions and physical damage should not be treated as automatically proving one causal chain.

topics.label: Immediate safety warnings
topics.scope_note: Shipping and air restrictions concern local hazards; environmental and wider economic effects are different questions.

topics.label: Supply and wider effects
topics.scope_note: No immediate loss of operating flows can coexist with future price, winter-supply or environmental harm.

method.country_note: Outlet countries describe origin. Claimant countries describe an office, organization or stated residence, not assumed citizenship.
method.claim_type_note: A fact claim is a checkable statement, not a fact verified by this graph. Opinions, predictions, legal positions and promises are marked separately.
method.edge_note: Green arrows point from a supporting claim to the claim receiving support. Grey comparisons have no assigned direction. Solid red arrows point from a source claim to a target claim it is proposed to contradict. Red direction follows the analyst-assigned comparison order. Every proposed conflict retains its reasoning and scope limits for human review.
method.attention_note: Attention is a qualitative reading of the saved article, with paragraph locators; it is not a measured share of words.
method.endorsement_note: A quoted speaker’s view is separate from the article narrator’s view. No outlet-wide position is inferred from one article.
method.cleaning_note: Uses saved recovered text. CNN and Sputnik each have one recovered paragraph, so exact excerpts identify their claims. The date attached to Global Times’ final-day reference comes from the September 23 sample’s Izvestia article.
